dimensions.assessment: Applies to passengers and families using future Amtrak-owned and operated passenger trains.
dimensions.evidence: This bill requires Amtrak passenger rail trains to have a baby changing table in at least one restroom in each car

dimensions.assessment: Minor physical additions of baby changing tables and signage in train restrooms.
dimensions.evidence: Each restroom described in paragraph (1) shall clearly indicate with signage the presence of a baby changing table

dimensions.assessment: No specific spending amounts are stated, though purchasing and installing changing tables involves minor capital costs for new rail cars.
Amends Title 49 of the United States Code to add a specific equipment mandate for newly acquired Amtrak rail cars.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 243 of title 49, United States Code, is amended by inserting after section 24313 the following

dimensions.assessment: Permanent requirement for all newly solicited Amtrak-owned passenger rail cars moving forward.
dimensions.evidence: was solicited for purchase after the date of the enactment of the Baby Changing on Board Act

missing_information: Estimated cost of installing baby changing tables
Number of future rail cars expected to be purchased
importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires Amtrak to install baby changing tables in at least one restroom of each car on passenger rail trains owned and operated by Amtrak that are solicited for purchase after enactment. The direct effect is limited to future Amtrak rail car purchases.
